The download date and the file's SHA-256 become part of the receipt.

Could not reach https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data/pums/2018/5-Year/unix_hus.zip from this machine (URLError: <urlopen error Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden (agent proxy: no rule or network setting allows this host)>). That is evidence about this machine's network, not about the link; check it from another network before treating the data as unavailable.

Files the code both writes and reads are already in the package: ${scratch}/czeffects.dta, ${tocensus}/czeffects.dta, ${tocensus}/czranking6_alt-wage.dta. A run may read these instead of recomputing them. A receipt must say whether it replayed them or recomputed them, and a matching output hash alone does not show recomputation.
211 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
